source_title: CBI probes foreign funds to Arunachal activist
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: CBI is learnt to be probing inward remittances made by at least four foreign entities to an activist in Arunachal Pradesh in violation of the FCRA provisions.According to an FIR filed by the agency in Aug, the entities are based in the Philippines, Ireland and the UK, and CBI is likely to seek details from them regarding these transactions, sources said. It is also being investigated whether more such individuals received funds from these organisations.One of the foreign NGOs which allegedly made the transfer has been identified in the FIR as Asia Indigenous Peoples Network on Extractive Industries and Energy.
